snacs_rules_notes.txt:
Useful general rules from purchased examples:
1) since in time-expressions -> role/function p.Time/p.Time.
2) Genitive 's on proper names/people can be p.Gestalt/p.Gestalt.
3) Possessive pronouns before human-owned nouns often construe as role p.OrgMember with function p.Possessor (e.g., our business).
4) of in 'rewards of this program' can be p.Force/p.Force when the NP is the force/source underlying an abstract outcome.
5) Each of can be p.QuantityItem/p.Whole.
6) of in 'proud of...' can be p.Stimulus/p.Topic.
7) your before a noun can be p.Agent/p.Gestalt when the possessor is an actor/agentive participant.
8) throughout in 'throughout the year' is p.Duration/p.Duration.
9) to in 'recommend ... to anyone' is p.Recipient/p.Goal.
10) possessive your in 'save your money' can be p.Possessor/p.Possessor.

Caveat: do not overgeneralize possessive pronoun labels; choose based on semantic relation in context (possessor, agent-like, org member, etc.).
